programme.desc: We take a look back at some of the most spectacular and important goals from previous Premier League seasons.

programme.title: PL REWIND - EP10
programme.desc: Michael Owen burst onto the scene for Liverpool at just seventeen years of age, and in two consecutive seasons the teenage sensation won the Premier League Golden Boot. Owen recalls those campaigns for the Reds, reliving the key moments that helped him develop into one of the greatest players of his generation.

programme.title: PL REWIND - EP7
programme.desc: David James is one of the Premier League's most memorable goalkeepers. Few can match the England international for his longevity in the top flight, where he played with distinction between 1992 and 2010. He shares his memories of the key matches and best saves of his career.

programme.title: THE BIG INTERVIEW - EP12
programme.desc: Marc Guehi arrived at Manchester City as an FA Cup winner with Crystal Palace before winning the same trophy with his new club 12 months later. The centre-back sits down with The Big Interview to talk about becoming a key figure in Enzo Maresca's team, as well as how a love for music has formed a key part of his life.

programme.title: THE BIG INTERVIEW - EP11
programme.desc: At just 16 years and 361 days old, Rio Ngumoha became Liverpool's youngest ever goalscorer, scoring a 100th minute winner on his Premier League debut at Newcastle. The records kept on falling in the 2025/26 season as the young winger went from wonderkid to first team regular. The East Londoner reflects on his meteoric rise and the importance of family support along the way.

programme.title: THE CATCH-UP SHOW - EP13
programme.desc: Relive the standout moments of the 2026/27 season so far as The Catch-Up Show brings together the very best programming and digital content, showcasing unforgettable interviews, defining stories and fan favourites.

programme.title: CLASSIC MATCH - LIV v MUN
programme.desc: We delve into the Premier League archive to bring you a Classic Match from the 2010/2011 season.
